functions.name: delete-webhook-subscription
functions.description: Delete an existing webhook subscription by ID, removing that notification-delivery registration. This does not delete survey or response data.

webhookSubscriptionId.description: Opaque identifier of the existing webhook subscription to delete, obtained from list-webhook-subscriptions on the same account.

FunctionInput_kno_commerce_deletewebhook.description: Identifies the existing webhook subscription registration to delete.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the subscription whose deletion the provider accepted.

deleted.description: True only after the provider has established successful deletion; this does not guarantee cancellation of notifications already in flight.

FunctionOutput_kno_commerce_deletewebhoo.description: Provider-confirmed deletion of the requested webhook subscription registration.

tags.instructions: Use `list-webhook-subscriptions` first to find the exact subscription ID. This removes the registration for that destination and its configured events, not survey or response records. No restoration operation is available here; in-flight notification behavior is provider-defined. If the result is uncertain, inspect the subscription list before attempting deletion again.

functions.name: get-attribution-analytics
functions.description: Retrieve the provider's default attribution analytics report. This provider resource is deprecated and scheduled for removal; no replacement is documented.

FunctionInput_kno_commerce_getattributio.description: Request the default attribution report without caller-defined filters.

anyOf.description: A native numeric dimension value, not an inferred measure.

dimensions.description: Provider dimension names mapped to their native scalar values, such as channel labels when supplied; no dimension meaning is invented.

metrics.description: Provider numeric measure names mapped to native values or explicit null. Units and scale remain those of the provider; no percent, currency, or time conversion is inferred.

metadata.description: Other row attributes that are not established dimensions or numeric measures, preserved structurally with provider keys; omitted when absent.

items.description: One attribution result row with native dimensions, measures, and unmapped attributes.

rows.description: Attribution result rows in source order. A flat summary can be represented as one row with no dimensions; the precise source layout is provisional.

metadata.description: Report-level context or measure descriptions when supplied, retaining native structure and provider-defined units; omitted when absent.

FunctionOutput_kno_commerce_getattributi.description: The default attribution report, preserving provider-defined values without inferred units.

__schema0.description: A native JSON value, preserving nested structure and explicit null.

tags.instructions: Use this only for existing attribution-reporting needs while the deprecated resource remains available. The tool requests the default report without invented date or dimension filters. For underlying survey answers use `list-survey-responses`. Treat returned metric names and dimension values as provider-defined and do not assume undocumented units.

functions.name: get-survey-response-count
functions.description: Get the provider-reported survey response count for the connected account's accessible response collection.

FunctionInput_kno_commerce_getsurveyresp.description: No input parameters; reads the response count with the provider default scope.

count.description: Provider-reported number of survey responses visible to this connected client under the count endpoint's default scope. It is not a page length or a synthesized estimate.

tags.instructions: Use this when you need a response count without retrieving answers. Use `list-survey-responses` to inspect the records. This tool applies no invented filters and does not promise a count consistent with a separate page read at another instant.

text.description: Benchmark question wording as ordinary Unicode text, when supplied.

type.description: Provider question type, preserved verbatim when supplied.
